<description>
These backports re-enable building release binaries on RISC-V hardware.
</description>

<commits>
58938225a1 guix: Skip some packages' tests in `python-lief` and `nsis-x86_64`

`python-lief` and `nsis-x86_64` transitively pull in packages whose
tests fail when building natively on `riscv64`:
- `python-lief`: `python-psutil`, `python-pytest-xprocess`, `python-sh`
- `nsis-x86_64`: `python-psutil`

Github-Pull: bitcoin/bitcoin#36233
Rebased-From: f14a3ef8c5c6480f2e452d9668db71786cdb83fc

a5e6a09956 guix: Update time-machine to `60f6956aeffa7f30285745bd0ea615e9acfc74f8`

This is necessary to unblock building on RISC-V systems.

Fixes https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/36232.

Github-Pull: bitcoin/bitcoin#36233
Rebased-From: feb77d838eda70dfc27df78537da89f2b568f52c

f3d71b11e1 guix: declare python-setuptools

Since we bumpted to python 3.12, setuptools is no longer provided by
default:

https://docs.python.org/3.12/whatsnew/3.12.html#ensurepip

[quoted text omitted]
Github-Pull: bitcoin/bitcoin#36425
Rebased-From: 11977b42acc54e2abcd8e06272a8f44865cf40a4

7ec938c5cc guix: update certvalidator for Python 3.12

Python 3.12 removed imp, breaking the pinned Certvalidator test loader.

achow101 rebased allow-more-criticals onto upstream, which includes the
loader fix.

However the runner preloads oscrypto's OpenSSL backend, whose discovered
library names cannot be resolved in the isolated Guix build. Set its
supported OSCRYPTO_USE_OPENSSL variable to absolute library paths from
the existing OpenSSL input so the test suite can run.

Github-Pull: bitcoin/bitcoin#36425
